A '''golden sword''' is a [[Weapons#Sword|sword]] of the [[Golden equipment|golden]] tier, crafted from two [[gold ingot]]s and a stick. It is weaker than a [[copper sword]] but comes with [[Looting]] I.

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}

=== Loot ===
{{Sources}}

== Usage ==

=== Combat ===
It deals {{Hp|4}} damage at an attack speed of 1.6 and has 350 durability. Golden gear comes with its enchantments already applied. They are ordinary enchantments, so they can be combined or removed like any other.

=== Repairing ===
It can be repaired in an [[anvil]] with [[gold ingot]]s. The pack resets repair costs to zero, so it can be repaired indefinitely; see [[Repairing]].

=== Smelting ingredient ===
{{Uses}}

In a [[blast furnace]] it melts down into one gold ingot.
